# Description list

<p class="gls-text-lead">Easily create nice looking description lists, which come in different styles.</p>

## Usage

Add the `.gls-description-list` class to display terms and descriptions below each other.

```html
<dl class="gls-description-list">
    <dt></dt>
    <dd></dd>
</dl>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<dl class="gls-description-list">
    <dt>Description term</dt>
    <dd>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.</dd>
    <dt>Description term</dt>
    <dd>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.</dd>
    <dt>Description term</dt>
    <dd>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.</dd>
</dl>
</div>

## Divider modifier

Add the `.gls-description-list-divider` class to add a horizontal line between list items.

```html
<dl class="gls-description-list gls-description-list-divider">
    <dt></dt>
    <dd></dd>
</dl>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
